name: nemotron_asr
description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming 0.6B on Strix Halo: speech recognition in 40 languages for uploads and live audio

releases.notes: An upload that does not decode as audio is answered with `400 invalid_audio_input` instead of 500 (extension API 0.3.22); transcription unchanged from 0.2.0. Built on Gufo 0.37.0.
`--live-lookahead 0|3|6|13` sets how often live sessions send text (every 0.08 to 1.12 s, default 0.56 s); `gufo model install nemotron-3.5-asr` installs the tested weights. Built on Gufo 0.35.0.

Uploads and the realtime WebSocket from the Hugging Face directory, with language detection; every matrix product on the matrix cores, tokens identical to the reference's offline transcription. Built on Gufo 0.34.0.
